Scialfa, Patti
Home » Statistical Information » Relations » Scialfa, Patti

Vivienne Patricia "Patti" Scialfa (born July 29, 1953, Deal, NJ) is an American singer-songwriter and guitarist. She grew up in the Jersey Shore community of Deal, New Jersey, being the middle child of Joseph Scialfa and Patricia (née Morris) Scialfa. Her father was of Sicilian ancestry and her mother is from Belfast, Northern Ireland. She also has half-siblings from her father's second marriage. Patti has been a member of The E Street Band since June 25, 1984, just one day after her audition and just 4 days before the start of the Born In The U.S.A.-tour. She has been married to Bruce Springsteen since 1991, having 3 children together (Evan James Springsteen, Jessica Rae Springsteen and Samuel Ryan Springsteen). In 2014, Scialfa was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame as a member of the E Street Band.

Source: Wikipedia
